locations.change: the writer fills the shared name-character table from Character.isUnicodeIdentifierStart / isUnicodeIdentifierPart without skipping the code points for which Character.isIdentifierIgnorable is true

fault.semantic_root_cause: The Unicode identifier syntax admits, as a part character, every code point that is ignored when identifiers are compared; the JavaScript grammar does not. A table of the characters a JavaScript name may be written with therefore cannot be filled from java.lang.Character's Unicode identifier predicates alone, however faithfully it reproduces them.
